Q1.name: cron-stampede
Q1.why: two workflows scheduled at the same minute contend for runners and API budget

Q2.name: unpinned-action
Q2.why: a mutable tag (or none) can change under you or be taken over

Q3.name: write-all-default
Q3.why: a pushing workflow with no `permissions:` runs with the repo default (often write-all)

Q4.name: self-push-without-skip-ci
Q4.why: a commit step without [skip ci] re-triggers the workflow (push trigger => loop)

Q5.name: duplicate-producer
Q5.why: two workflows write the same artifact path (the class of bug that made /audit lag /audit3)

Q6.name: orphan-artifact
Q6.why: a produced JSON that no workflow consumes (dead output, or a consumer was renamed)

Q7.name: silent-failure
Q7.why: continue-on-error or `|| true` on a gate-shaped step hides a failed check

Q8.name: missing-timeout
Q8.why: no timeout-minutes is the phantom-queue generator (runs hang until GitHub kills them)

Q9.name: secret-sprawl
Q9.why: one secret referenced by more workflows than the fan-in bound widens blast radius

Q10.name: dead-schedule
Q10.why: a cron whose workflow has not run in > 2x its interval is silently dead
